limits: All six are dirty development runs at design base345163b. Final clean-six reruns are still required; this report does not supply or predict those results.
A syscall-entry ptrace stop is before kernel ioctl execution. It proves a real Special blocking closure reached the actual syscall, not an in-kernel active or hung ioctl.
SET_CONFIGURATION releases original interface claims before the stopped ioctl; independent sysfs driver=null is the expected observation. Cached current_drivers is not retained-claim evidence.
CLEAR_HALT actually returns QEMU ECM -EPIPE/-32, faithfully preserved. No successful endpoint-halt recovery or real physical-hardware result is claimed.
In EOF modes the old TCP connection is closed before release: there is no claimed old-wire terminal response. The actual ioctl return and retained ownership/cleanup are independently recorded.
Wire assertions are from the source-hash-matched independent probe and its raw case output; no separate packet capture is present.

Guest coordinator/tracer verify PID starttime, FD node identity, UID/caps and separate helper. Raw held/exit node identities and guest assertion markers are retained, but individual stat/status reads are not separately dumped. Host isolation reflects the source-matched dedicated QEMU harness and recorded topology, not a general host syscall audit.
